bugs.text: Normal-stage enemies are set to 'pending' and then to 'fly' (1373) instead of 'enter'; the 'fly' case removes the enemy when its path ends (1399). The 'enter' case that would park it in the formation (1378-1391) is never reached. Every enemy flies to its slot and vanishes, so the formation never forms and stages clear themselves: 4-play-015s.png shows stage 3 at 650 points.

Dives and enemy fire never happen in normal stages: updateDives only picks state 'form' enemies (none exist), and maybeEnemyFire is only called in the unreachable 'enter', 'dive' and 'escort' cases. The player is never shot at and no enemy ever returns to its slot.
The tractor beam, capture, rescue, dual fighter and captive fire are all unreachable: startTractor is only called from updateDives on a 'form' boss. The signature mechanic never appears in play.

Entry path variant m=4 starts at (112, H+20), straight up through the player's start/respawn position x=112, y=250 (939-940, 1054). Once the 2 s invulnerability ends, the next group's bottom-entry enemy rams the player. The play-test lost all three ships this way within about 20 s of starting (2-after-enter-5s.png READY with one reserve; 4-play-030s.png back on the title).
Challenge-stage bosses are created with hp 1, so drawEnemy renders them in the blue 'already hit' palette from the start instead of green (4-play-015s.png, 4-play-060s.png).
GOEI_A/B and BOSS_A/B are the same pixel map with a different palette letter; all three enemy types are plain diamonds, so the types are told apart by colour only.
Challenge-stage paths are one random cubic Bezier from top to bottom per enemy, not the spec's looping group patterns; enemies scatter individually.
Formation sway/breathe offsets are computed but never affect anything visible: entry targets are frozen at spawn and no enemy ever sits in formation.
hitEnemyByBullet is monkey-patched after definition to add challenge hit counting; it works but makes the hit path hard to follow.

summary: The file is well organised, complete and error-free: clean state/update/render split, a fixed-timestep loop, a pixel font, sprite canvases, seven synthesized Web Audio sounds, localStorage high score, stage flags, a results screen and a full challenge-stage scorer. But one wrong state name sinks the game as Galaga: entering enemies go 'pending' -> 'fly' instead of 'enter', so they trace their curved entry paths to their slots and are deleted on arrival. No formation ever forms, nothing sways or breathes, nothing dives, no enemy fires in a normal stage, and the tractor beam, capture, rescue and dual fighter (all written out in detail) can never trigger. Stages clear themselves every ten seconds or so while the player shoots at fly-ins for formation points, and the bottom-centre entry path rams the player at its spawn point as soon as invulnerability lapses, which ended the play-test in about twenty seconds. The challenge stage is the only part that plays roughly as intended, with random rather than looping paths and bosses drawn in the hit colour. It looks like Galaga on the title and HUD and feels nothing like it in play.
